definitions: Plural form of staff, referring to a stick or rod.
Plural form of staff, referring to the horizontal lines on which musical notes are written.
Plural form of stave, referring to one of the curved strips of wood that form the sides of a barrel or cask.
examples: The old man leaned on his staves.
The composer wrote the melody across five staves.
The cooper carefully fitted the staves together to make the barrel.
